LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT (SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT)

This Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 between Mr. A. Sharma, the Licensor, and Ms. B. Rao, the Licensee, for the premises at 12 MG Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka (the "Premises").

1. TERM. The licence is for eleven (11) months commencing on 1 March 2026.
2. LICENCE FEE. The Licensee shall pay a monthly licence fee of Rs. 45,000/- on or before the 5th day of each month.
3. SECURITY DEPOSIT. The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only) on or before the date of possession. The deposit shall be refunded within thirty (30) days of the Licensee vacating the Premises, after deducting any amounts towards unpaid licence fee, damages and painting charges.
4. LOCK-IN. Neither party shall terminate this Agreement during the first six (6) months from the Commencement Date, save as provided in Clause 9.
5. MAINTENANCE. The Licensee shall bear minor repairs. Structural repairs shall be the responsibility of the Licensor.
6. ENTRY AND INSPECTION. The Licensor may inspect the Premises on reasonable notice.
7. SUBLETTING. The Licensee shall not sublet the Premises.
8. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
9. TERMINATION. Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving two (2) months' written notice after the lock-in period.
